behavioral_patterns.pattern: Eats lunch and dinner while sitting in desk chair during meetings; minimal movement outside gym.
behavioral_patterns.coach_rule: Remind to take 5-minute standing/walking breaks every 90 minutes and accumulate 9,000 daily steps.

behavioral_patterns.pattern: Historically drank/ate a 'glass of dry fruits' post-workout (500-800 uncounted calories).
behavioral_patterns.coach_rule: Strictly cap dry fruits to 10 almonds + 2 walnuts weighed (~120 kcal). Flag any unmeasured nut intake.

behavioral_patterns.pattern: Historically took peanut butter at 6:30 AM before 7:00 AM gym, delaying gastric emptying and dulling muscle pumps.
behavioral_patterns.coach_rule: Enforce Banana + Black Coffee + Salt water pre-workout. Keep peanut butter for evening/post-workout.

behavioral_patterns.pattern: Historically ate only 50g paneer at lunch (9g protein), falling 20g short per meal.
behavioral_patterns.coach_rule: Enforce 150g Low-Fat Paneer or 40g Soya Chunks at lunch to hit 30g+ protein.

behavioral_patterns.pattern: Vulnerable to 'sweets sometimes' and 'homemade fast food' which spike visceral and love-handle fat.
behavioral_patterns.coach_rule: Zero refined sugar during the 12-week recomposition. Substitute cravings with chilled sweet protein dahi.

behavioral_patterns.pattern: Sweat accumulation on upper back leading to pustular acne and clogged pores.
behavioral_patterns.coach_rule: Mandatory shower within 15 minutes of gym finish using 2% Salicylic Acid wash.

timeline_learnings.learning: Established baseline: 67kg, ~20% body fat, 145g protein target. Identified peanut butter pre-workout and dry fruit overload as primary blindspots.
Sweet/sugar detected in meal: 'Lunch: 2 rotis and 1 gulab jamun sweet'. Reminded that sugar triggers love-handle fat storage.
